statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The purpose is to correlate symptoms with rhythm changes and capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits rules indicating care may be covered by another payer
